releases.name: GemLoop
releases.summary: Are you smart enough to recognise a city based on 4 images from buildings / landmarks within that city? Do you know everything there is to know about the cities of the world? Great buildings, famous streets and landmarks? Then this game is for you! Play against your friends and family in a classic shootout for pure knowledge! ------ - Time based bonuses!- Earn new and more challanging rounds! - New levels added all the time!

releases.name: Flappy Wings Multiplayer
releases.summary: This is a cool diving game. You have to tap the screen for your diving champion to dive exactly in the middle of the target... You get 5 tries per level and a set number of points to obtain knowing that by diving right at the center of the target, you win 10 points.Controls: Try to land in the middle of the target to get the most points.

releases.name: Pinball Chemist
releases.summary: Welcome Aboard! AlchemicalNet is hiring and you are being given the promotion of a lifetime! From here on out your job is to find new elements and use them to probe all the portals we've discovered! Break all the pegs, do it quickly and set a high score to pay off your debt! GET TO WORK!

releases.name: Pogo Gnom
releases.summary: ??DESIGN YOUR LOVELY MARKET!?? Have you ever wanted to design and decorate your own Fruit Market? Now you can in Fruit Market designer. Become a superstar designer as you decorate and expand your Fruit Market! Customize every element of your Fruit Market: furniture,decor, food,toy and more. Increase your Market's value and collect income in Fruit Market designer. ??Fruit Market - CARTOON STYLE?? Incredible! Nearly 200 cartoon style items to customize your Fruit Market with! You are the princess and it is your Fruit Market. FEATURES: ? Hundreds of stylish items to customize your villa. ? Four types of Fruit Market to be designed. ? Sell your creation to get more cash. ? Intuitive and easy to play for all ages. ? Share your home with your friends over Facebook ? Play with families--Have more fun.

releases.name: Last Delivery
releases.summary: Get the pizza to the penthouse of a disaster-prone apartment block: repair the lift, drain the laundry, survive the renovation, and dodge the rooftop inspectors before the order goes cold.

releases.name: Glass Drop
releases.summary: Time for some Space Adventure!!!It’s time to sharpen your reflexes as you cruise through the cosmos in the game.Mission Space is all about taking control of the spaceship and reach for the destination. Guide the spaceship along the defined pathway without falling off the track. Collect all the space objects within the predefined time and head towards the destination after collecting the key. Timing is the key while collecting the space objects as they disappear after the time gets elapsed. So make sure to collect as many as space objects to get a good score.The Features:•Tilt the device to move the spaceship•No Time Limit•Intuitive gameplay•Collect key to advance to higher levelsCruise your way to victory. Get set and go!!!!

releases.name: Tower of Fangs: Summoned to Another World, I Was Locked in a Tower with 299 Strikers, Only the Last Egoist Goes Home
releases.summary: From the makers of 'The Adventures of Señor Gato' and 'Ghetto Jetpack' comes Cranium Crack Trivia.Don't let the timer run out on this epic trivia game.You are given 3 chances to answer the trivia questions before the time runs out.  You will be asked a trivia question from one of three categories - Entertainment, Politics, Sports, and General Knowledge.The faster you answer the question, the more points you will accumulate.  Get the highest score to claim bragging rights on the GameCenter Leader Boards.Finish the trivia game for a special appearance by Senor Gato.Game Features include:- Fun Trivia Questions- GameCenter Leader Boards- Easy Gameplay- Great Looking Graphics- Funny Theme

releases.name: Moto Racing Manager
releases.summary: Become a motorcycle racing manager! Optimize your bike, develop your rider, master changing conditions and make crucial race decisions. Compete in leagues, tournaments and championships in single-player or multiplayer and race your way to the top!

releases.name: The Road Remembers
releases.summary: A roguelite told in plain words. Each seed is a road, and each hero who walks it leaves their mark: the thing they took stays taken, the village they saved holds a feast for the next stranger, their cairn holds their sword, and the guardian they fought is still wounded. The road remembers.

releases.name: Gravebound Rising
releases.summary: Enjoy the HD Graphics and Battle in space to destroy every planet and try not to get destroyed. Compete with your friends and see who can destroy the most planets. Instructions: tap = shoot pinch = rotate swipe = move

releases.name: STAtIC (Noisy Ether Sakura Games)
releases.summary: Welcome to the most challenging cricket game on iOS. This game is designed to make sure that you do NOT hit 6 sixes in an over. Not that easily, anyways.Batting as a single batsman, you help your team chase down scores against a gallery of brutish bowlers. Battle your way through googlies, doosras, in-swingers, out-swingers, yorkers and a host of other fiendish tricks. The game even lets you pace your innings – you can defend or attack, hit sixes, take singles or rotate strike.The free version has the following features:1) Four levels of run chases - from 3 to 20 overs. Level 1 (3 overs) is unlocked by default. As you win games more levels get unlocked for free.2) Practice mode to get your timing right. After all, batting is all about timing.3) Two modes of play - an Easy mode to get started and, for the experts, a tougher level with 3-over run chases.4) Weeks of thrilling, nerve-wrecking run chases – all for freeBetter still, you take to the crease in the irresistible form of the one and only “Fat Batsman”.A paid-for Pro version lets you do away with the ads, and unlocks all 4 levels for you straight away.So what are you waiting for? It’s time to start batting.

releases.name: Escape the Playground
releases.summary: The sunny ocean coast is now taken over by evil zombies. Get your special bike and kill them all! Feel the thrill of racing like never before in this action-packed, heart-thumping 'Zombies vs Biker' Bike racing Game . Go ahead and live out your racing dream. FEATURES: *Ragdoll Physics *26 Exciting Levels * Crazy addictive gameplay with ultra smooth tilt controls * Eye popping high definition 3D graphics * Environments that keeps changing * Life like character animations and physics * Endless game play. * 10 Bikes to select for racing

releases.name: Teryon Crisis
releases.summary: *** TOP SHOOTER ACTION ****** ALL ITEMS UNLOCKED ***The city has been overrun by thugs and shotgun toting rednecks. Time for Jackson to come clean up the mess! Take your weapon to the limit in this non-stop action hero rampage of a shooter! Will you survive it?* Non stop 3D action gameplay!* Thumping sound track!* Guns, missiles, jeeps bad guys galore!Compete with your friends on the Game Center Leaderboards TODAY!

releases.name: Miniciv
releases.summary: Miniciv is an accessible hex‑grid 4X turn‑based strategy. Start with one city and settler, explore and build your budding civilization into a mighty empire. Procedural maps and flexible playtime bring unique runs, pairing easy entry with deep political, trade, faith and industrial mechanics.

releases.name: STEEL VANGUARD:Project ARES
releases.summary: Set in a sci-fi world, this top-down shooter challenges you to complete missions and earn the title of “ARES,” the strongest pilot. Collect modules that appear after clearing each wave to customize and upgrade your mech as you see fit, and aim to clear every wave all the way to the end.

releases.name: Prison Escape io
releases.summary:
Think you can outsmart the guards and make your great escape? 

Team up with friends or compete against them in this heart-pounding multiplayer adventure! Navigate through trap-laden ventilation shafts, secret tunnels, and guarded hallways as you work together - or race to outdo each other. 

Gather coins along the way to unlock stylish outfits and boost your performance. Power-ups will be your savior when things get tough, so keep an eye out for them. 

Can you and your crew escape before it's too late?

releases.name: How to Wait for the Bus
releases.summary: The bus will arrive when it arrives. In the meantime, make some tiles explode. Fire coloured tiles into the board from any edge. Line up three or more matching tiles to make them explode, trigger chain reactions, and gradually clear the board.

releases.name: Deuce Dash
releases.summary: Drag to swing, aim and smash your way through bite-sized arcade tennis tournaments. Time powerful serves, chain rally combos, unleash fireball shots and earn diamonds to unlock a wardrobe of stylish players.

releases.name: Fsh
releases.summary: Fueled with Spite and Rage, explore a strange land and fight your way to get your stolen eyes back.

releases.name: Furnished
releases.summary: FURNISHED is a cozy interior design sandbox game where you sketch a floor plan and bring it to life by filling it with furniture: sofas, chairs, tables, beds, pictures, plants, trees, toys... Paint every wall, set the lights and mood, then take a pic or walk through the place. There's lots to do!

releases.name: Beat the Meat
releases.summary: Congratulations. You have a job. Unfortunately, it is this one. Welcome to a small diner where the customers are impatient, the conversations are questionable, and apparently nobody has heard of a meat tenderizer.

releases.name: Forgery : Before the Law (Study)
releases.summary: Push the box and go beyond the gate. A warehouse keeper-style 3D puzzle adventure inspired by Kafka's novels and myths. A short game exploring an absurd inner world across 6 stages.
